mapper.sql: r.id, r.rule_name, r.item_id, i.item_name, i.item_code, r.critical_stock, r.safety_stock, r.notice_stock, COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) AS current_stock, r.enabled, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time

FROM wms_inventory_warning_rule r LEFT JOIN wms_item i ON r.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.item_id, SUM(inv.quantity) AS total_qty FROM wms_inventory inv JOIN wms_item_sku s ON inv.sku_id = s.id GROUP BY s.item_id ) inv ON r.item_id = inv.item_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_inventory_warning_rule r LEFT JOIN wms_item i ON r.item_id = i.id

SELECT r.id AS "ruleId", r.rule_name AS "ruleName", r.item_id AS "itemId", i.item_name AS "itemName", i.item_code AS "itemCode", r.critical_stock AS "criticalStock", r.safety_stock AS "safetyStock", r.notice_stock AS "noticeStock", COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) AS "currentStock" FROM wms_inventory_warning_rule r LEFT JOIN wms_item i ON r.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.item_id, SUM(inv.quantity) AS total_qty FROM wms_inventory inv JOIN wms_item_sku s ON inv.sku_id = s.id GROUP BY s.item_id ) inv ON r.item_id = inv.item_id WHERE r.enabled = '1' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
